title: Local console access
responsibility: Supplies local history files and the cached access guard used by the reports server.

outputs.name: consoleDirectory
outputs.description: Resolved history directory from the trimmed console-data environment setting, or undefined when unset.

outputs.name: consoleData
outputs.description: Disk-backed guarded readers. Older revision JSON is enriched with source metrics from its exact Git commit when the configured project checkout is available; immutable files and verdict records are not changed. Cache contains at most four immutable revision observations. Missing files remain undefined.

outputs.name: consoleServer
outputs.description: Lazily cached ConsoleAccess configured from owner mode, bind address and address-header settings, with local data and portable export support.
